result.rationale: The rescue team repeatedly fails to make progress on the primary objective (rescue-two-civilians stays at 0/2 through all 6 turns) while suffering sustained attrition. The dominant causal bottleneck is survival/spatial pressure: Engineer Imani is repeatedly damaged by Raider Holt's scatter-blast (100→71→46) and by the reactor environment hazard (46→36→26→16), dropping to 16/100 health. Security Chen also takes reactor environment damage (110→100→90→80) and then 25 damage from Raider Holt (80→55) plus reactor damage (55→45). Meanwhile the reactor-heat climbs monotonically 62→70→78→86→94→100, crossing the threshold at turn 4 and staying maxed. The team's movement repeatedly routes through the reactor zone (reactor-entry, reactor-console) which is the source of the environmental damage, and the medic's escort of civilian-sato is contested at turn 4 (target_zone_capacity_lost) blocking extraction. The intended rescue affordance (recover civilian) is never realized because hostile pressure (Raider Holt attacks) and environmental reactor hazard drain health faster than the team can act, and the reactor-heat threshold crossing at turn 2/4 compounds the pressure. This is a survival/spatial-pressure bottleneck rather than a local-policy or information problem: the civilians are known (kade at life-console, sato at med-ward), routes are known, but hostile and environmental pressure blocks the actors before the rescue affordance becomes actionable.
